scripts.data: node scripts/map/gtfs.mts && node scripts/map/model.mts && node scripts/dining/menus.mts && node scripts/laundry/rooms.mts && node scripts/map/places.mts && node scripts/laundry/model.mts
scripts.data:missing: node scripts/map/gtfs.mts --if-missing && node scripts/map/model.mts --if-missing && node scripts/dining/menus.mts --if-missing && node scripts/laundry/rooms.mts --if-missing && node scripts/map/places.mts --if-missing && node scripts/laundry/model.mts --if-missing
scripts.prebuild: npm run data:missing && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.worker: node scripts/laundry/rooms.mts --if-missing && wrangler d1 migrations apply notunh --local && wrangler dev --test-scheduled
scripts.deploy: npm run data && npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply notunh --remote && wrangler deploy
